messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected on prod-inference-service (route: /v1/generate). PagerDuty incident PD-9823 created and trigger fired. Immediate on-call escalation policy applied.

pd-bot: PagerDuty PD-9823 assigned to primary on-call Priya Shah. Escalation timer: 2m.

Priya Shah: acking — on it. looking at console and trying to correlate errors with capacity.

pd-bot: No ack from primary within 2m. Escalating to secondary: Miguel Rivera.

Miguel Rivera: I'm up. what's the symptom? any stack traces?

Ethan Cole: 1) sustained 500s on /v1/generate 2) avg latency jump to ~1.2s 3) errors look like upstream grpc timeout. sample: ```json
{ "ts": "2026-03-14T15:23:12Z", "path": "/v1/generate", "status": 502, "latency_ms": 1203, "instance": "inference-worker-3" }
```

Asha Patel: k8s events show OOMKill on inference-worker-3 around 15:21:30Z. node memory pressure on eu-west-1-dedicated pool.

Priya Shah: Console shows dedicated pool at 95% GPU mem, CPU throttling. Smart routing already falling back to hosted variants but backlog built up.

incident-bot: PD escalation: manager notified due to missed secondary ack window. Manager notification sent to Samantha (oncall-manager).

Samantha (oncall-manager): awake, joining. Miguel, do you want me to trigger reserved-capacity scale or try pod restart first?

Miguel Rivera: attempting safe restart of failing pod first. `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/inference-worker --field-selector metadata.name=inference-worker-3`

Ethan Cole: rolling restart started. also enabling prefix-level cache for that route: `redwood config set cache.prefix true --route /v1/generate --duration 60s` to reduce duplicate upstream fetches.

Miguel Rivera: pod restarted, model loader logged transient failure then succeeded. new pod ready at 15:26:41Z. healthchecks green. 5xx rate falling (from ~42% -> ~6% over 3m).

Priya Shah: initial customer impact estimate: approx 9 minutes of elevated errors, ~12% of requests experienced errors during spike window. We have 4 open customer tickets related to failed generations; one enterprise customer reported increased retry traffic contributing to load.

Samantha (oncall-manager): good triage. Please do a temporary rate-cap on that enterprise key and follow up with CS. If errors stay >5% for 15m, escalate to infra for capacity bump.

Miguel Rivera: applied rate cap to key: `redwood tokens update --id k_ABC123 --qps 5` — monitoring.

incident-bot: PD-9823 acknowledged by Miguel Rivera at 2876543299. Auto-escalation canceled.

Ethan Cole: adding logs link and short dump: https://logs.redwood/svc/prod/inference/2026-03-14/15:20-15:30

Priya Shah: creating a postmortem stub and linking CS tickets: https://confluence.redwood/INC-9823-stub — will populate root cause (OOM on worker due to model prefetch + retry storm) and the remediation plan (better backpressure + per-customer qps limits).

Samantha (oncall-manager): Miguel, please own the RCA and remediation runbook. Priya, coordinate customer comms with CS. Ethan, add an alert to detect retry-loop patterns next time.

Miguel Rivera: will do. handing monitor to next on-call in 30m. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: thanks team — ending thread but keeping watch.

incident-bot: Closing note: incident stabilized, PD-9823 status: acknowledged -> resolved pending postmortem.
